resources.string: If the app has a problem, send a report to Nourax Support so we can fix it. Reports are saved in your NoDrive and shared with Nourax Support. They never include passwords.

• What you type in "What went wrong?"
• The app version, the Android version, the phone model and the language
• The date and time, and the name of your NoDrive server
• If the app crashed: the technical details of the crash
• The recent activity log of the app on this phone. It includes the names of your files and folders, because we need them to find the problem.

Never included: passwords, app passwords, sign-in tokens and cookies. Email addresses are replaced with <email>.

The report is saved in your NoDrive, in the folder "Problem reports", and shared read-only with Nourax Support.
